facts.text: The hotel is at 700 Wilshire Boulevard in Santa Monica, just blocks from the beach, the Pier and Third Street Promenade.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located at 700 Wilshire Boulevard in Santa Monica, just blocks from the beach, the Pier, and Third Street Promenade.

facts.text: The hotel is 0.4 miles, an 8-minute walk, from Santa Monica Beach.
facts.excerpt: Santa Monica Proper Hotel is located 0.4 miles (8-minute walk) from Santa Monica Beach

facts.text: The hotel's interiors were designed by Kelly Wearstler.
facts.excerpt: The hotel was designed by acclaimed interior designer Kelly Wearstler, who blended coastal-modern aesthetics with layered textures.

facts.text: The hotel combines a restored 1920s landmark building with bold design.
facts.excerpt: Santa Monica Proper combines a restored 1920s landmark with bold design

facts.text: Rooms in the re-imagined landmark building have a Spanish Revival influence.
facts.excerpt: Serene, stylish rooms in the re-imagined landmark building provide a distinctive taste of Spanish Revival influence, freshly spun into the present.

facts.text: Bathrooms have walk-in travertine showers, marble vanities and Aesop bath products.
facts.excerpt: well-appointed bathrooms equipped with walk-in travertine showers, marble vanities, and premium Aesop bath products

facts.text: Garden Terrace King rooms, on the second floor, have private walled-in patios with lush plantings.
facts.excerpt: Garden Terrace King rooms feel worlds away, thanks to lush plantings on the private, walled-in patios positioned to maximize lounging and privacy. These rooms, located on the second floor of the hotel

facts.text: Proper Sleep Rooms pair Eight Sleep sleep technology with Kelly Wearstler design.
facts.excerpt: Pairing Eight Sleep’s best-in-class sleep technology with Proper’s signature Kelly Wearstler design

facts.text: Sleep Rooms include Filterbaby water filtration in the bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Filterbaby water filtration ensures every part of your bathing ritual is pure and refreshing.

facts.text: The Family Suite sleeps up to six guests in two connected bedrooms with two separate bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: with the room to accommodate up to six guests in two connected bedrooms (with one King and two Queen beds)

facts.text: Guests in the larger suites get access to a private alcove at the rooftop pool, on reservation.
facts.excerpt: Guests also enjoy access to a private alcove at the rooftop pool, available upon reservation.

facts.text: Sunset One Bedroom Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with sunset views and original art.
facts.excerpt: Our Sunset One Bedroom Suite is a multi-purpose space furnished with original art and thoughtfully chosen, mid-century inspired furnishings. Light pours in through floor-to-ceiling windows with spectacular sunsets in the evenings

facts.text: The heated rooftop pool has views of the surf, coastline, mountains and cityscape.
facts.excerpt: offering breathtaking views of the surf, coastline, mountains, and cityscape

facts.text: The rooftop pool is heated and family-friendly.
facts.excerpt: Heated, expansive, and family-friendly, our rooftop pool is designed for restorative downtime.

facts.text: The rooftop has cabanas, private alcoves and a circular bar with a fireplace.
facts.excerpt: relaxing in cabanas or private alcoves, gathering at the circular bar with a fireplace

facts.text: The rooftop hosts vinyl-only DJ sets and curated social events.
facts.excerpt: From vinyl-only DJ sets to curated social events, our rooftop is home to moments that bring the Proper community together, with a view.

facts.text: Surya Spa is a collaboration with Ayurvedic doctor, chef and herbalist Martha Soffer.
facts.excerpt: a collaboration with internationally acclaimed Ayurvedic doctor, chef, and herbalist Martha Soffer

facts.text: Surya Spa offers therapeutic massage, steam and oil treatments, Dosha Yoga consultations and Panchakarma programs.
facts.excerpt: Surya offers therapeutic massage, steam and oil treatments, cooking, yoga, meditation, personalized Dosha Yoga consultations, and cleansing Panchakarma programs

facts.text: Surya's signature Abhyanga is a four-handed massage with warm herbalized oils cooked overnight.
facts.excerpt: Surya’s Abhyanga is a rejuvenating, four-handed massage that uses customized, warm herbalized oils, cooked all night for the next day’s use

facts.text: Spa treatments can also be given in the guest room.
facts.excerpt: or inside the comfort of your Proper hotel room

facts.text: Surya Spa has herbal-infused steam rooms, fountain patios and a herbal oil-making station.
facts.excerpt: Surya Spa features six private treatment rooms, a meditation room, herbal-infused steam rooms, fountain patios, and an intimate herbal oil-making station

facts.text: Two private Recovery Suites, Hyperion and Soma, offer red light, PEMF and compression therapy, cold plunges, dry sauna and the Ammortal Chamber.
facts.excerpt: Hyperion focuses on regenerative techniques, with red light, PEMF, and compression therapy, while Soma focuses on performance-based therapies, including cold plunges, dry sauna, and our Ammortal Chamber experience

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24/7, with complimentary yoga and bootcamp classes and VO2 Max testing.
facts.excerpt: Open 24/7, it features expert programming, personal training, and complimentary yoga and bootcamp classes. VO2 Max testing

facts.text: The hotel provides beach volleyball gear, Electra bikes and beach towels.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy activities such as beach volleyball, cycling with Electra Bikes, and relaxing with beach towels.

facts.text: Proper Retreats are three-day, fully customized wellness retreats.
facts.excerpt: A three-day, fully customized wellness retreat, done the Proper way.

facts.text: Past retreat partners include Hundred Health, Peloton and Goop.
facts.excerpt: Past retreat partners include Hundred Health, Peloton, and Goop.

facts.text: Calabra is an indoor-outdoor rooftop restaurant with Pacific views and Mediterranean-Californian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Dine alongside sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean at Calabra, an indoor-outdoor rooftop bistro and beach-inspired lounge in Santa Monica.

facts.text: Palma is an art-filled lobby lounge for all-day dining.
facts.excerpt: linger in the art-filled lobby lounge, Palma, a captivating setting for all-day dining

facts.text: The hotel's kitchens cook without seed oils.
facts.excerpt: all crafted without seed oils

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, up to two per room.
facts.excerpt: Santa Monica Proper welcomes dogs (up to two per room, each under 45

facts.text: Non-guests can use the rooftop pool with day passes, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Non-guests may also enjoy the pool via day passes, subject to availability.

facts.text: Proper Club members have full access to the rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests and Proper Club members have full access.

facts.text: The hotel is the Westside's only rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: Proper boasts the Westside’s exclusive rooftop pool

facts.excerpt: 2026 #1 City Hotel in Greater Los Angeles
